done 54503278, report /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/bugs/b20-1088-tuple-option-part-in-arms.md.report.md

#1088 is fixed and committed locally (not pushed). A tuple with a `T?` part at the end of a `match`, an `if` or a block now gets `Some` on that part, the same as the tuple written directly.

**The fix:** `check_overflow_list_into_nullables` now passes those forms to a new function, `check_overflow_ends_into_nullables`. When every end is a tuple literal or `null`, it wraps each tuple end separately. It compares each end with its own type, taken from `state.arm_types`. Comparing against the type of the whole `match` didn't work: there `s.clone()` already looks optional, so it never got wrapped. `ends_in_tuple` and `tuple_ends` in `check_texts.nika` are now `pub` so it can reuse them.

**Tests:**
- All five rows (a-e) failed with E0308 on the unfixed binary.
- The new test `tuple_option_part_in_arms` fails on the unfixed binary (8 rustc errors) and passes now. Besides rows a-e and the two forms that already worked, it covers a text-literal end and nested ends.
- I ran the 73 `tests/compiler` programs named tuple/nullable/option/tail/widen in a scratch project with `--both-settings`: all passed.
- The `lower-std` fixpoint is clean. `cargo fmt`, clippy (1.97 here and 1.99.1, the version CI uses) and `pre-push-check.sh` all pass. I redrew the self-hosted badge because `pre-push-check.sh` asked for it.

**Found (an older, separate bug, recorded under `Found:`, which cuts the batch):** the unfixed binary has it too. A function returning `match x { 0 => (1, null), else => (2, "lit") }` as `(i32, String?)` is refused with NK1104. This only happens when its result and another function's `(2, t.clone())` result are passed to the same `(i32, String?)` parameter. The report has the full probe; I suspect the text-tier handling of tuple parameters. Because of this, the new test reads the text-literal case through `let (a, b) = literal(i)` instead of the shared `show` helper.

**Disk:** I deleted the separate clippy 1.99.1 target directory, which freed under 1 GB. The test cache is 3.0 GB with 6.6 GB free. One new cache entry over 100 MB: `build-time-parsers/768d2772d43bb4cc`, 1030 MB.
